en.hook: Two textbooks, two DH conventions, one arm, and nobody complains when I mix them up. I find that rude.
en.mission: In `code/main.py` change `q = [0.5, 0.8]` to `q = [0.0, 0.0]`. Do `craig` and `wrong` still disagree? Predict, then run `python3 code/main.py`.
